Class GameMap

java.lang.Object
logic.map.GameMap
public class GameMap extends Object
Mutable map model containing grid tiles, build decorations, and computed path waypoints.

Tile encoding: { 0}=grass, { 1}=path, { 2}=castle.

  • Method Details

    • generatePath

      public List<Waypoint> generatePath()
      Builds an ordered path from a border path tile (1) to castle (2) via BFS. If no castle path is found, falls back to generateWaypointsFromGrid(int).
